items: The techniques of chromatography are very useful in organic synthesis for separation, isolation and purification of the products. They are equally important in qualitative and quantitative analyses and for determination of the purity of a substance.
Chromatography is very useful for identifying complicated chemicals such as dyes, drugs and pesticides.
On which basis the components of a mixture are separated from one another in paper chromatography?
What are the stationary and mobile phases in paper chromatography?
How the purity of a substance is determined by using paper chromatography?
